claims.sentence: You have the right to appeal the results of your thesis defense
You may file an appeal if you believe there was a violation of the established procedure for conducting the state final certification
You must submit your appeal no later than the next working day after the results of the state final certification are announced
To do this, send a scanned copy of the appeal application, signed and with your full name deciphered, to the Office of Educational Programs at education@innopolis.ru

After you submit your appeal, the Secretary of the State Examination Commission forwards the following to the Appeal Commission via email: a scanned copy of the Commission's meeting minutes, a scanned copy of the Chairman's conclusion on compliance with procedural issues, the video recording of the defense, and the thesis, review, and reference (if necessary)

The Chairman of the Appeal Commission conducts an online meeting to consider your appeal via video conference (using Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or similar software) no later than 2 working days after you submit the appeal application
The Secretary of the Appeal Commission keeps a record of the meeting and records the session

On the day of the Appeal Commission meeting, the Chairman notifies the Methodological Department of the results by sending an email with a scanned copy of the meeting minutes to education@innopolis.ru
You will receive notification of the appeal decision via email to your corporate email address no later than the next working day after the Appeal Commission meeting
The decision of the Appeal Commission is final and not subject to review
If necessary, the State Examination Commission may conduct a repeat thesis defense in the presence of one member of the Appeal Commission
An appeal against a repeat state final certification is not accepted
The evidence does not define what qualifies as a violation of the established procedure
The evidence does not specify the format or content requirements for the appeal application beyond the signature and name deciphering
The evidence does not specify who constitutes the Appeal Commission or how its members are selected
The evidence does not specify the criteria the Appeal Commission uses to make its decision
The evidence does not specify what happens if the repeat defense is also failed
